description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the description-only polishing asks the skill names verbatim ('make this pushier', 'will this ever fire') plus the audit flags it consumes (too-short, no-trigger-prefix). Near-misses use the skill's own one-field-per-turn exclusion: rewriting the body of a skill (skill-writing), reviewing a whole skill for quality (skill-reviewer), and running the lint gates themselves (lint-skills). Counterexamples guard the 'description' homonym in non-artifact contexts, which the skill's Do-NOT list names (READMEs, product copy).

queries.q: make this skill description pushier, it never triggers
will this rule's description ever fire on 'set up a worktree'?
audit_skill_descriptions flagged code-review as too-short — rewrite the description
give me three variants of the frontmatter description for the new command
die Beschreibung im Frontmatter von diesem Skill ist zu schwach, mach sie triggerfreudiger
rewrite the procedure section of this skill, steps 3 and 4 are wrong
queries.note: changes the body, which this skill's Do-NOT list excludes (one field per turn) → skill-writing

queries.q: review the whole skill for quality before I merge it
queries.note: a full-artifact review, not a single-field polish → skill-reviewer

queries.q: run the skill linter and fix what it reports
queries.note: running the lint gate itself rather than rewording one field → lint-skills

queries.q: write a product description for our new pricing page
queries.note: the 'description' homonym on content that is not an agent artifact, which this skill's Do-NOT list names
a PR body, not frontmatter — the skill's Do-NOT list excludes non-artifact text
